text: The fix is straightforward: the `load_config` function was returning a copy of `defaults` without applying any environment overrides. I added logic to iterate over `env` keys, pick those starting with `APP_`, strip the prefix, lowercase the remainder, and if that key exists in `defaults`, coerce the value to the type of the default (using a helper `_coerce` that handles `bool` specially). This makes the test pass.
